# Popover

Display actions on-click, related to the clicked component on a content cell.
See [Popover guidelines<i class="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/popover/design/)

It is used internally by the following components

- <LinkTo kind="Components/ComboBox" story="basic">
    ComboBox
  </LinkTo>
- <LinkTo kind="Components/DatePicker" story="basic">
    DatePicker
  </LinkTo>
- <LinkTo kind="Components/Menu" story="basic">
    Menu
  </LinkTo>

<Source code="import { Popover } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

- Any other props supplied will be provided to the root element

## Examples

```css
.w-288 {
  width: 288px;
}
.p-1\/2 {
  padding: 0.5rem;
}
```

### Dark mode

<Canvas of={PopoverStories.Dark} />

Details about implementing dark mode is available in <LinkTo kind="General/Visual Styles/Introduction" story="docs">Visual styles Page</LinkTo>

### Placement

Use `placement` and `fallbackPlacements` props to define where you prefer the Popover to appear.

<Canvas of={PopoverStories.Placement} />

### Arrow

Use `arrow` and `arrowClassName` to hide or customize the arrow.

<Canvas of={PopoverStories.Arrow} />

```css
.custom-tooltip-arrow:before {
  background-color: #ffffff !important;
  border: 1px solid #666 !important;
  color: #333 !important;
}
```
